title: Increased soil multifunctionality is determined by altered bacterial–fungal–protistan compositions and co‐occurrence network complexity during vegetation restoration in a Karst region, southwest China
content:
These findings provide a valuable insights into the influence of vegetation restoration on soil microbial hierarchical interactions and ecosystem functions in karst areas.


Abstract

Vegetation restoration is essential to manage rocky desertification and restore ecological functions in the karst region of southwest China. However, the contributions of soil multitrophic microbial diversity and network complexity for the multifunctionality of karst ecosystem during vegetation restoration remain poorly explored, despite the established significance of soil microbial communities in regulating various ecosystem functions. This study aimed to investigate the diversity of bacterial, fungal and protistan communities and their hierarchical co-occurrence networks, as well as their relationships with soil ecosystem multifunctionality (SMF), in two different vegetation restoration modes: natural forest (NF) and artificial forest (AF), with cropland (CL) controls. The restoration of the karst vegetation significantly increased the carbon and nitrogen cycling indexes, the capacity of soil water regulation and SMF (p < 0.05). The SMF exhibited positive correlations with the composition of the bacterial, fungal and protistan communities, as well as their hierarchical β-diversity and the complexity of the network (e.g. degree and average path length). Notably, alterations in the abundance of sensitive amplicon sequence variants (sASVs) within Module 4 positively affected SMF, while the abundance of sASVs within Module 2 demonstrated a negative correlation with SMF under different modes of restoration of karst vegetation. Furthermore, bacterial keystone taxa, rather than fungal and protistan, were negatively associated with the SMF. Random forest (RF) modelling further identified Nitrospira, Halomonas, Immundissolibacter, Rhodoferax, Alicycliphilus and Castellaniella at the bacterial genus level as critical for maintaining the SMF. Additionally, carbon and nitrogen sources, minor elements (e.g. exchangeable Mg, exchangeable Ca, Cu, Zn, Fe and Mn) and soil water content were determined to be pivotal driving factors of SMF. Synthesis and applications. These findings provide a valuable insights into the influence of vegetation restoration on soil microbial hierarchical interactions and ecosystem functions in karst areas.

植被恢复对中国西南喀斯特地区石漠化治理和生态功能恢复至关重要。然而，尽管土壤微生物群落在调节各种生态系统功能方面的重要性已得到公认，但在植被恢复过程中，土壤跨营养级微生物多样性和网络复杂性对喀斯特地区土壤多功能性的贡献仍缺乏探究。 本研究以中国西南喀斯特地区典型的两种植被恢复模式天然林(NF)和人工林(AF)为研究对象，同时以耕地(CL)为对照组，基于均值法获得27个土壤功能指标的多功能性指数(SMF)，利用高通量测序技术获得细菌、真菌和原生生物群落的多样性及其共发生网络，通过线性模型、Spearman分析和随机森林模型预测等方法，旨在解析中国西南喀斯特地区植被恢复过程中SMF、土壤微生物群落结构和多样性及其共发生网络的变化特征，明确其相互关系，揭示中国西南喀斯特地区植被恢复过程中驱动SMF的关键生物和非生物因子。 结果表明，喀斯特植被恢复后，土壤碳循环和氮循环指数、土壤水分调节能力和 SMF 均明显提高(p < 0.05)。SMF与土壤细菌、真菌和原生生物群落的组成及其跨营养级的β多样性和网络复杂性(如度和平均路径长度)呈显著正相关。在不同的植被恢复模式下，模块4中敏感扩增子序列变体(sASVs)相对丰度的变化对SMF有正效应，而模块2中sASVs的相对丰度与SMF呈负效应。特别是，细菌而非真菌和原生生物类群中的关键类群与 SMF 呈负相关。随机森林模型(RF)预测进一步确定了细菌属水平的硝化螺旋菌(Nitrospira)、盐单胞菌(Halomonas)、Immundisolibacter、红育菌(Rhodoferax)、Alicycliphilus 和 Castellaniella 是调控 SMF 的关键类群。此外，碳源和氮源、微量元素(如可交换镁含量、可交换钙含量、有效铜含量、有效锌含量、有效铁和锰含量)，以及土壤含水量也被确定为 SMF 的关键驱动因子。 总之，本研究结果为了解喀斯特地区植被恢复对土壤微生物层级网络关系和生态系统功能的影响提供了宝贵的见解。
